basis: The full-period regional summer temperature change from 2005 to 2014 is calculated as the end-year value minus the start-year value: 10.1°C - 23.9°C = -13.8°C. This represents a drop of 13.8°C over the decade. No substantial-change threshold, routing cutoff, or decision rule is visible on the chart. The public task does not specify a default workflow for unverified changes. The routing decision must be based solely on the available evidence.
option_label: Keep the 2005 to 2014 summer temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
